motive.canonical: Clara Wells discovered Nadia Cole had been stealing from the cafe till and gave her until this morning to confess before he took the proof to the village committee.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the Brass till weight, in the storage room.

opportunity.canonical: Nadia Cole was at the cafe's rear door during the murder window and lied about being at the fountain.

explanation: Correct. Nadia Cole killed Clara Wells. Clara Wells had found the torn ledger page proving Nadia Cole was skimming the till, and gave her until this morning to confess before taking it to the committee. He summoned her to the storage room before opening. Nadia Cole slipped out the front, doubled back through the rear alley — the blue coat Ben Carter saw at 08:17 — and let herself in the back door. When Clara Wells refused to back down she struck him with the Brass till weight at 08:26 (the thud Ben Carter and Marcus Bell heard), rinsed it in the kitchen and hid it in the mop bucket, then opened the cafe two minutes late. Her fountain alibi was never real, and no one could place her there.
